summary.name: github
summary.description: Read and open issues, comments and pull requests in GitHub repositories, as a private GitHub App on your account.

setup.summary: Creates a private GitHub App, on your account or an organization's, that may read contents and write issues and pull requests, and installs it on the repositories you choose. Uninstalling removes the installation; the app stays on GitHub until you delete it under GitHub Apps in the account's settings.

fields.title: Account
fields.words: An organization's name, or leave it blank for your personal account

keeps.words: The app's private key, which Kivali signs with to get a token for each call

connection.verify_message: Connected as kivali-acme[bot], the app Kivali Acme, installed on acme

requirements.title: Connection test

requirements.title: The app's key works
requirements.words: GitHub accepts the key of the app Kivali Acme. Uninstalling GitHub here leaves the app on GitHub, for you to delete in its settings at https://github.com/organizations/acme/settings/apps/kivali-acme.

requirements.title: Permissions current
requirements.words: The installation lacks permissions this version needs: pull requests: write. Approve them on GitHub.

step.words: Enter this code on the service’s page, then approve the sign-in there. Kivali finishes it here once you do.
